changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Requeue previously indexed videos without an embedded capture date so the video metadata extractor can refresh them once after this upgrade.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE indexed_file AS indexed SET indexer_status = 'SCHEDULED', index_update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_message = 'Upgrade: video capture date metadata refresh scheduled', version = COALESCE(indexed.version, 0) + 1 WHERE indexed.index = 'MEDIA' AND indexed.indexer_status = 'COMPLETED_WITH_SUCCESS' AND LOWER(indexed.name) ~ '[.](3gp|avi|m4v|mov|mp4)$' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM media_file AS media WHERE media.file_id = indexed.id AND media.exif_gps_date IS NULL AND media.exif_date_image_taken IS NULL );
